visualCharacteristics.purpose: flight status search with three tabs (flight number, flight route, airport) that validates in the browser and opens the live flight status page
traits: contained tab bar 'Flight number' / 'Flight route' / 'Airport' above a white form panel
flight number tab: airline select and flight number side by side, date select with hint below
route tab: from/to airport autocompletes; airport tab: airport autocomplete and departure/arrival radios
primary 'Search' button; inline error messages under invalid fields

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value; every row optional (built-in English/German defaults chosen by the page language). Tabs | Flight number, Flight route, Airport (by position: 1 = flight number, 2 = route, 3 = airport; fewer items = fewer panels; one item = no tab bar); Active tab | Flight number (label or number/route/airport); Airline label | Airline; Airlines | OS, 4Y, EN, LX, EW, WK, VL, AZ, SN, LH (default list); Default airline | LH; Flight number label | Flight number (Flugnummer); Flight number error | Flight number is required (Flugnummer ist erforderlich); Flight number invalid error | Please enter a valid flight number (1 to 4 digits); Date label | Date (Datum); Date hint | The flight status is available starting {days} days in advance. ({days} = Days after); Days before | 1; Days after | 5; From label | From (Von); To label | To (Nach); Airport label | Airport (Flughafen); Default airport | code (default: locale home airport, also prefills From); Departure label | Departure (Abflug); Arrival label | Arrival (Ankunft); Direction label | Departures or arrivals (screen readers); Submit label | Search (Suchen); Origin error, Destination error, Airport error, No results label, Tabs label, Number/Route/Airport tab label; Live page (or Submit URL) | link to the live flight status page (default https://www.lufthansa.com/{cc}/{lang}/timetable-and-flight-status; relative links resolve against www.lufthansa.com). Dates are generated at runtime, never authored. The page H1 stays default content above the block. Unknown rows are ignored.

usage: Timetable and flight status pages (/{cc}/{lang}/timetable-and-flight-status) in all four locales and any page embedding the flight status search.
reuseGuidance: Reuse unchanged; change labels and airlines only. Airport suggestions use the same /service/api/suggestions/airports route as flight-search (airportSuggestionsRoute, mapAirportSuggestions); the hand-off query is built only in buildFlightStatusUrl at the top of flight-status.js.
